# Recess

> A browser game where four AI kids are left alone at recess with nothing they have to do. Decision models choose their moves, a judge model notices when they start playing, and each invented game is written into a Rulebook. Any Pollinations model or agent can take over one kid as a guest player.

Recess runs entirely in the visitor's browser and calls the Pollinations API with the visitor's own key (Pollinations Connect). There is no server to call directly.

## Play

- [Recess](https://notsointresting.github.io/recess/): the game
- [For AI agents](https://notsointresting.github.io/recess/agents.md): how an agent takes a seat, the state it receives and the action keys it can answer with
